functions.name: mbedtls_oid_get_numeric_string
functions.signature: int mbedtls_oid_get_numeric_string(char *buf, size_t size, const mbedtls_asn1_buf *oid);
functions.description: Converts a DER-encoded ASN.1 OID into its dotted-decimal string form (e.g. "\x2A\x86\x48\x86\xF7\x0D" -> "1.2.840.113549"). Writes a NUL-terminated string to buf and returns the length excluding the final NUL. Available when MBEDTLS_X509_USE_C is enabled.
requirements: buf must point to a writable buffer with capacity size bytes.
size must be large enough to hold the full dotted-decimal representation plus a terminating NUL; otherwise the function returns PSA_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL.
oid must be a non-NULL pointer to an mbedtls_asn1_buf that contains a valid DER-encoded OID.
The function is available only if MBEDTLS_X509_USE_C is enabled at compile time.
Callers should check the return value: on success it is the number of characters written (excluding the NUL); on error it is PSA_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL.

functions.name: mbedtls_oid_from_numeric_string
functions.description: Parses a dotted-decimal OID string (e.g. "1.2.840.113549") and produces its DER-encoded form into oid->buf, allocating memory from the heap on success. The caller must free oid->buf with mbedtls_free(). Returns 0 on success or an ASN.1 error code on failure. Available when MBEDTLS_X509_CREATE_C is enabled.
requirements: oid must be a non-NULL pointer to an mbedtls_asn1_buf structure writable by the function.
On success, the function allocates oid->buf from the heap; the caller must release it using mbedtls_free().
oid_str must point to a string containing a valid dotted-decimal OID representation.
size must be the length of oid_str and must not include any null terminator.

Returns 0 on success; returns MBEDTLS_ERR_ASN1_INVALID_DATA if oid_str does not represent a valid OID; returns MBEDTLS_ERR_ASN1_ALLOC_FAILED if allocation of oid->buf fails. Callers must handle these return codes.
The function is available only if MBEDTLS_X509_CREATE_C is enabled at compile time.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_dn_gets
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_dn_gets(char *buf, size_t size, const mbedtls_x509_name *dn);
functions.description: Format an X.509 Distinguished Name (DN) into a human-readable string and write it to buf, writing at most size bytes. Returns the length of the string produced (excluding the terminating nul) or a negative error code.
requirements: buf must point to a writable buffer of at least size bytes.
size limits the maximum number of characters written.
dn must point to a valid mbedtls_x509_name chain.
Caller must check the return value: negative values indicate an error; non-negative is the number of characters written (excluding the terminating nul).

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_string_to_names

requirements: head must point to a pointer that is NULL on entry (the function allocates and sets the head of the list).
On success, the caller must later free the list with mbedtls_asn1_free_named_data_list().
name must point to a valid, null-terminated DN string representation.
Caller must check the return value: 0 on success, negative on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_dn_get_next
functions.description: Return a pointer to the first attribute-value pair of the next Relative Distinguished Name (RDN) in an X.509 name sequence. Intended for iterating DNs while respecting multi-valued RDN boundaries.
requirements: dn must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid mbedtls_x509_name node within a parsed DN chain.
Use the result to detect RDN boundaries by comparing against dn->next as suggested in the note.
Returns NULL if the end of the sequence is reached.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_time_cmp

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_time_gmtime

Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; non-zero indicates failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_time_is_past
functions.description: Check whether the given time is in the past compared to the system time. Returns 1 if the time is in the past or if an internal error occurred, 0 otherwise. Intended usage: if (is_past(valid_to)) error.
requirements: to must be a non-NULL pointer to an initialized mbedtls_x509_time.
Relies on system time; ensure the system clock is set appropriately.
Caller must handle the convention that 1 can indicate either "in the past" or an internal error.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_time_is_future

Relies on system time; ensure the system clock is set appropriately.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_parse_subject_alt_name
functions.description: Parse a single Subject Alternative Name (SAN) item from its raw ASN.1 buffer into an mbedtls_x509_subject_alternative_name structure. Supports rfc822Name, dnsName, directoryName, uniformResourceIdentifier, and otherName.hardware_module_name. May allocate additional memory; free with mbedtls_x509_free_subject_alt_name. The returned structure contains pointers into the original certificate buffer; its lifetime is tied to the certificate.
requirements: san_buf must point to the raw data of a single SAN item (e.g., an element from crt->subject_alt_names).
san must be a non-NULL pointer to writable storage for the parsed SAN.
Caller must call mbedtls_x509_free_subject_alt_name(san) to free any extra memory allocated by this function.
Only the documented SAN types are supported; function returns MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE for unsupported types.
Do not use the embedded pointers after the owning certificate buffer is freed.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_free_subject_alt_name
functions.description: Release any additional memory owned by an mbedtls_x509_subject_alternative_name previously populated by mbedtls_x509_parse_subject_alt_name.
requirements: san should be the same structure (or a copy thereof) previously initialized by mbedtls_x509_parse_subject_alt_name.
Do not call twice on the same live allocation (double-free risk is implementation-defined).
san may be NULL only if the implementation explicitly allows it (unknown from header); otherwise pass a valid pointer.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_cn_inet_pton
functions.description: Parse a Common Name (CN) string as an IP address and write the binary representation to dst. Parses as IPv6 if the string contains ':', otherwise as IPv4. Returns the number of bytes written (4 for IPv4, 16 for IPv6) or 0 on failure.
requirements: cn must be a valid, null-terminated string representing an IPv4 or IPv6 address.
dst must point to a writable buffer of at least 16 bytes; for use as struct in_addr, it should be 4-byte aligned as noted.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates parsing failure; non-zero indicates the number of bytes written.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crl_parse_der
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crl_parse_der(mbedtls_x509_crl *chain, const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: Parse a DER-encoded X.509 Certificate Revocation List (CRL) from memory and append it to the provided CRL chain. Intended for applications that load a single CRL blob in DER format and want to build/extend a chain of CRLs. Returns 0 on success, or a specific X509/PEM error code on failure. PSA Crypto must be initialized prior to use.
requirements: PSA Crypto must be initialized by calling psa_crypto_init() before calling this function.
chain must point to the start of a CRL chain (typically initialized with mbedtls_x509_crl_init).
buf must point to a buffer containing DER-encoded CRL data.
buflen is the size of buf in bytes (for PEM this would include the terminating NUL, but this function expects DER).
chain, buf must be valid, non-NULL pointers.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; nonzero is a specific X509 or PEM error code.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crl_parse
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crl_parse(mbedtls_x509_crl *chain, const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: Parse one or more CRLs from memory (PEM or DER) and append them to the provided CRL chain. Multiple CRLs in a single call are only accepted when input is PEM. Returns 0 on success, or a specific X509/PEM error code on failure. PSA Crypto must be initialized prior to use.
requirements: PSA Crypto must be initialized by calling psa_crypto_init() before calling this function.
chain must point to the start of a CRL chain (typically initialized with mbedtls_x509_crl_init).
buf must point to a buffer containing CRL data in PEM or DER format.
Multiple CRLs in a single buffer are accepted only when using PEM format.
buflen is the size of buf in bytes; for PEM input it should include the terminating NUL byte.
chain, buf must be valid, non-NULL pointers.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; nonzero is a specific X509 or PEM error code.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crl_parse_file
functions.description: Load one or more CRLs from a file (PEM or DER) and append them to the provided CRL chain. Multiple CRLs in a single file are only accepted when the file is PEM-formatted. Returns 0 on success, or a specific X509/PEM error code on failure. PSA Crypto must be initialized prior to use. Available only when MBEDTLS_FS_IO is enabled at build time.
requirements: This function is available only if MBEDTLS_FS_IO is enabled at compile time.
PSA Crypto must be initialized by calling psa_crypto_init() before calling this function.
chain must point to the start of a CRL chain (typically initialized with mbedtls_x509_crl_init).
path must be a valid, readable filename to a file containing CRLs in PEM or DER encoding.
Multiple CRLs in a single file are accepted only when using PEM format.
chain and path must be valid, non-NULL pointers.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; nonzero is a specific X509 or PEM error code.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crl_info
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crl_info(char *buf, size_t size, const char *prefix, const mbedtls_x509_crl *crl);
functions.description: Write a human-readable summary of a CRL into the provided buffer. The output is prefixed on each line with the supplied prefix. Returns the length written (excluding the terminating NUL) on success, or a negative error code on failure. Only available when MBEDTLS_X509_REMOVE_INFO is not defined.
requirements: This function is available only if MBEDTLS_X509_REMOVE_INFO is not defined at compile time.
buf must be a writable buffer of at least size bytes; size specifies the maximum output size.
prefix may be NULL or a valid C string to prefix each output line (unspecified if NULL is allowed; if unsure, pass a valid string).
crl must point to a valid CRL to represent.
Caller must handle the return value: non-negative indicates number of bytes written (excluding terminating NUL); negative indicates an error.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crl_init
functions.description: Initialize an mbedtls_x509_crl structure for use as a CRL chain. Must be called before parsing/appending CRLs into the chain.
requirements: crl must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to an mbedtls_x509_crl structure.
Call this before any parse or info/free operations that use the CRL chain.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crl_free
functions.description: Release and unallocate all data associated with a CRL chain previously initialized and/or populated. Safe to call after use to avoid memory leaks.
requirements: crl must be a valid pointer to a CRL chain to free (behavior for NULL is unspecified by this header).
The CRL should have been previously initialized (e.g., via mbedtls_x509_crl_init), though freeing an uninitialized structure is unspecified by this header.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_csr_parse_der
functions.signature:
int mbedtls_x509_csr_parse_der(mbedtls_x509_csr *csr,
                               const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: Parse a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) provided in DER format and populate an mbedtls_x509_csr structure. Unsupported requested extensions are silently ignored unless marked critical, in which case the CSR is rejected. Requires the PSA crypto subsystem to be initialized before calling. Typical usage: initialize the csr with mbedtls_x509_csr_init(), call this function with the DER buffer, then use the parsed fields or verify the signature externally; call mbedtls_x509_csr_free() when done.
requirements: psa_crypto_init() must have been called before invoking this function.
csr must point to an initialized mbedtls_x509_csr structure (call mbedtls_x509_csr_init() first).
buf must point to a valid CSR in DER format and remain readable for buflen bytes.
buflen must be the exact size of the DER input buffer.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; otherwise, a specific X509 error code is returned.
If the CSR contains unsupported critical extensions, parsing fails (nonzero error).

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_csr_parse_der_with_ext_cb
functions.signature:
int mbedtls_x509_csr_parse_der_with_ext_cb(mbedtls_x509_csr *csr,
                                           const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen,
                                           mbedtls_x509_csr_ext_cb_t cb,
                                           void *p_ctx);
functions.description: Parse a CSR in DER format with a user-provided callback to handle unsupported extensions. For each unsupported extension encountered, the callback is invoked. If the callback fails on a critical extension, parsing fails; if it fails on a non-critical extension, the extension is skipped and parsing continues. Requires PSA crypto to be initialized. Use when custom or non-standard extensions must be processed during CSR parsing.
requirements: psa_crypto_init() must have been called before invoking this function.
csr must point to an initialized mbedtls_x509_csr structure (call mbedtls_x509_csr_init() first).
buf must point to a valid CSR in DER format and remain readable for buflen bytes.
buflen must be the exact size of the DER input buffer.
cb must be a valid function pointer of type mbedtls_x509_csr_ext_cb_t; it will be called for every unsupported extension.
The callback must return 0 on success or a negative error code on failure, and must be prepared to parse the extension value bytes [p, end).
If the callback returns a failure for a critical extension, this function fails; if it returns a failure for a non-critical extension, the extension is skipped.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; otherwise, a specific X509 error code is returned.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_csr_parse
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_csr_parse(mbedtls_x509_csr *csr, const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: Parse a CSR provided in either DER or PEM format and populate an mbedtls_x509_csr structure. For PEM, buflen includes the terminating null byte. Behavior regarding unsupported extensions matches mbedtls_x509_csr_parse_der. Requires PSA crypto to be initialized.
requirements: psa_crypto_init() must have been called before invoking this function.
csr must point to an initialized mbedtls_x509_csr structure (call mbedtls_x509_csr_init() first).
buf must hold the CSR data in DER or PEM format.
For PEM input, buflen must include the terminating null byte.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; otherwise, a specific X509 or PEM error code is returned.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_csr_parse_file
functions.description: Load and parse a CSR from a file (DER or PEM) into an mbedtls_x509_csr structure. Available only when MBEDTLS_FS_IO is enabled. Error codes mirror mbedtls_x509_csr_parse.
requirements: This function is available only if MBEDTLS_FS_IO is enabled at build time.
csr must point to an initialized mbedtls_x509_csr structure (call mbedtls_x509_csr_init() first).
path must point to a readable file containing a CSR in DER or PEM format.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; otherwise, a specific X509 or PEM error code is returned.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_csr_info
functions.signature:
int mbedtls_x509_csr_info(char *buf, size_t size, const char *prefix,
                          const mbedtls_x509_csr *csr);
functions.description: Generate a human-readable informational string describing the provided CSR and write it into the supplied buffer, optionally prefixing lines. Returns the number of characters written (excluding the terminating nul) or a negative error code. Available unless MBEDTLS_X509_REMOVE_INFO is defined.
requirements: buf must point to a writable buffer with at least size bytes available.
size must be large enough to hold the resulting text; otherwise, a negative error code may be returned or the output truncated per implementation.
prefix may be NULL or a valid C-string used as a line prefix.
csr must point to a parsed/initialized CSR to represent.
Caller must check the return value: non-negative length on success; negative on error.
This function is unavailable if MBEDTLS_X509_REMOVE_INFO is defined at build time.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_csr_init
functions.description: Initialize an mbedtls_x509_csr structure to a safe, empty state prior to parsing or use.
requirements: csr must be a valid pointer to storage for an mbedtls_x509_csr.
Call this before any parse or info operations on the csr.
After use, call mbedtls_x509_csr_free() to release resources.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_csr_free
functions.description: Release and zeroize the contents of an mbedtls_x509_csr structure and reset it to a safe state.
requirements: csr must be a valid pointer to an mbedtls_x509_csr previously initialized (and possibly populated) with mbedtls_x509_csr_init()/parse.
Do not use the csr for further operations unless reinitialized with mbedtls_x509_csr_init().

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_init
functions.description: Initialize an mbedtls_x509write_csr context prior to setting fields and writing a CSR.
requirements: ctx must be a valid pointer to storage for an mbedtls_x509write_csr.
Call this before any mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_* or write operations.
After use, call mbedtls_x509write_csr_free() to release resources.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_subject_name
functions.description: Parse and set the subject name in the CSR write context from a comma-separated string of OID type=value pairs (e.g. "C=UK,O=ARM,CN=Mbed TLS Server 1").
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
subject_name must be a NUL-terminated string formatted as a comma-separated list of RDNs with recognized OIDs and values.
Caller must check the return value: 0 on successful parsing; otherwise a specific error code is returned.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_key
functions.description: Set the key pair to include in and to sign the CSR with. The public key is embedded in the CSR; the private key from the provided mbedtls_pk_context is used for signing when writing the CSR.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
key must point to an initialized mbedtls_pk_context containing a suitable private key matching the desired signature algorithm.
The provided key must remain valid for the duration of CSR writing operations.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_md_alg
functions.description: Select the message-digest algorithm to use for the CSR signature (e.g., MBEDTLS_MD_SHA256).
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
md_alg must be a valid mbedtls_md_type_t supported by the library and compatible with the key and signature algorithm.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_key_usage
functions.description: Set the Key Usage extension flags in the CSR. Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on allocation failure. Note: the decipherOnly flag (bit 8, 0x8000) cannot be set via this function because it cannot typically be represented in an unsigned char.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
key_usage must be a combination of MBEDTLS_X509_KU_* flags that fit in an unsigned char (decipherOnly cannot be set using this function).
Caller must check the return value: 0 on success; PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_subject_alternative_name
functions.description: Set the Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension in the CSR from a provided list. Only dnsName, uniformResourceIdentifier, and otherName (as defined in RFC 5280) are supported. Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on failure.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
san_list must point to a properly constructed mbedtls_x509_san_list containing only supported SAN types: dnsName, uniformResourceIdentifier, or otherName.
Caller must check the return value: 0 on success; PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_ns_cert_type
functions.description: Set the Netscape Certificate Type extension flags in the CSR. Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on failure.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
ns_cert_type must be a combination of MBEDTLS_X509_NS_CERT_TYPE_* flags that fit in an unsigned char.
Caller must check the return value: 0 on success; PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_set_extension
functions.description: Add or replace an extension in the CSR by specifying its OID, criticality, and value (the content of the OCTET STRING). Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on failure.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
oid must point to the extension OID bytes and oid_len must specify its length.
critical must be 0 (non-critical) or 1 (critical).
val must point to the raw extension value (inside the OCTET STRING) and remain readable for val_len bytes.
Caller must check the return value: 0 on success; PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_free
functions.description: Free and clear the contents of an mbedtls_x509write_csr context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid pointer to an mbedtls_x509write_csr previously initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init().
Do not reuse the context after freeing unless reinitialized.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_der
functions.description: Write the CSR represented by the context into a DER-encoded structure, placing the data at the end of the provided buffer. The return value is the length of the data written, which indicates the starting offset (buf + size - len). Returns a specific error code on failure.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init() and configured (e.g., subject name, key, and MD algorithm set) prior to writing.
buf must point to a writable buffer of at least size bytes; data is written from the end backwards.
size must be large enough to hold the resulting DER CSR; caller must check the returned length to determine the start of valid data.
The key set in the context must include a suitable private key for signing.
Caller must check the return value: positive length on success; a specific error code on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_csr_pem
functions.description: Write the CSR represented by the context as a PEM string into the provided buffer. Returns 0 on success or a specific error code on failure. Available only when MBEDTLS_PEM_WRITE_C is enabled.
requirements: This function is available only if MBEDTLS_PEM_WRITE_C is enabled at build time.
ctx must be initialized with mbedtls_x509write_csr_init() and configured (e.g., subject name, key, and MD algorithm set) prior to writing.
buf must point to a writable buffer with at least size bytes available; it must be large enough to hold the entire PEM output including terminators.
Caller must check the return value: 0 on success; a specific error code on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_subject_alternative_name
functions.description: Add a Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension to a certificate being built. Supports SAN types: dnsName, uniformResourceIdentifier, IP address, otherName, and DirectoryName. Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, initialized mbedtls_x509write_cert.
san_list must point to a valid list of SAN entries; content must match RFC 5280 encodings of the supported types.
Callers should set subject/issuer, keys, and validity as appropriate before final DER/PEM writing.
Memory allocation may occur; handle PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der(mbedtls_x509_crt *chain, const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: Parse a single DER-encoded X.509 certificate and append it to a certificate chain. Internally copies the input buffer.
requirements: psa_crypto_init() must have been called before use.
chain must point to a valid mbedtls_x509_crt; for the first element, it must be initialized with mbedtls_x509_crt_init().
buf must point to readable DER data containing exactly one certificate, of length buflen.
Function copies input buffer; buf may be freed/reused after return.
Returns 0 on success; negative error code on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der_with_ext_cb
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der_with_ext_cb(mbedtls_x509_crt *chain, const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen, int make_copy, mbedtls_x509_crt_ext_cb_t cb, void *p_ctx);
functions.description: Parse a single DER-encoded certificate and append to chain, optionally copying the input, and invoke a callback for each unsupported extension and for certificate-policies containing unsupported policies.
requirements: psa_crypto_init() must have been called before use.
chain must be initialized (mbedtls_x509_crt_init() for first element).
buf must contain exactly one DER certificate; buflen is its size.
make_copy != 0 causes internal copy; make_copy == 0 transfers temporary ownership of buf until the cert is destroyed (same lifetime constraints as nocopy variant).

cb is called for each unsupported extension (and certain policy cases) and must return 0 on success or a negative error on failure; if it cannot parse a critical extension the overall parse fails; for non-critical, failure causes skipping the extension.
p_ctx is opaque and passed to cb.
Returns 0 on success; negative error code on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der_nocopy
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der_nocopy(mbedtls_x509_crt *chain, const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: Parse a single DER-encoded certificate and append to chain without copying the input; the library keeps a reference to the provided buffer.
requirements: psa_crypto_init() must have been called before use.
chain must be initialized (mbedtls_x509_crt_init() for first element).
buf must point to a readable buffer with exactly one DER certificate and remain valid and unmodified for the lifetime of the chain (until mbedtls_x509_crt_free(chain)).
buflen is the exact length of the DER data.
Returns 0 on success; negative error code on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_parse
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_parse(mbedtls_x509_crt *chain, const unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: Parse one DER-encoded certificate or one or more concatenated PEM-encoded certificates and append them to a chain. Permissive parsing for PEM: returns the number of certificates that failed to parse if at least one succeeded.
requirements: psa_crypto_init() must have been called before use.
chain must be initialized (mbedtls_x509_crt_init() for first element).
For PEM: buf must be NUL-terminated within buflen; may contain multiple certificates and non-certificate text between PEM delimiters. For DER: buf must contain exactly one certificate.
On partial success with PEM, positive return value equals number of failed certificates; on complete success returns 0; on total failure returns first negative error.
Input buffer may be reused/freed after return (internally copies).

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_file
functions.description: Load one or more certificates from a file and append them to a chain. Permissive parsing: returns count of failed certificates if at least one was parsed; otherwise returns first error.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_FS_IO at build time.
psa_crypto_init() must have been called before use.
chain must be initialized (mbedtls_x509_crt_init() for first element).
path must reference a readable file containing PEM and/or DER certificates.
Return 0 if all parsed, positive number of failures on partial success, or negative X509/PEM error code.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_path
functions.description: Load certificate files from a directory path and append them to a chain. Permissive parsing: returns count of failed certificates if at least one was parsed; otherwise returns first error.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_FS_IO at build time.
chain must be initialized (mbedtls_x509_crt_init() for first element).
path must be a directory/folder path accessible for reading; function loads one or more certificate files.
psa_crypto_init() must have been called before use.
Return 0 if all parsed, positive number of failures on partial success, or negative X509/PEM error code.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_info
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_info(char *buf, size_t size, const char *prefix, const mbedtls_x509_crt *crt);
functions.description: Write a human-readable summary of a certificate into the provided buffer, optionally prefixing each line.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_X509_REMOVE_INFO to be undefined at build time.
buf must be a writable buffer of at least size bytes.
size is the maximum number of bytes to write.
prefix may be NULL or a C-string used as a line prefix.
crt must point to a valid certificate.
Returns number of bytes written (excluding final NUL) or negative error code.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_info
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_info(char *buf, size_t size, const char *prefix, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Convert verification flags returned by certificate verification into a human-readable string, optionally prefixing lines.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_X509_REMOVE_INFO to be undefined at build time.
buf must be writable; size is its length limit.
prefix may be NULL or a C-string prefix.
flags should be the output accumulated from mbedtls_x509_crt_verify* APIs.
Returns number of bytes written (excluding final NUL) or negative error code.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_verify
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_verify(mbedtls_x509_crt *crt, mbedtls_x509_crt *trust_ca, mbedtls_x509_crl *ca_crl, const char *cn, uint32_t *flags, int (*f_vrfy)(void *, mbedtls_x509_crt *, int, uint32_t *), void *p_vrfy);
functions.description: Verify a certificate chain against a list of trusted CAs and optional CRLs under the default security profile. Optionally check the peer name (CN/SAN) and invoke a user verification callback for each certificate.
requirements: crt must point to the certificate chain to verify (end-entity at head).
trust_ca may include trusted roots and/or explicitly trusted self-signed end-entity certs.
ca_crl may be NULL or a list of CRLs for the trusted CAs; if no CRL for a CA, revocation check for that CA is silently skipped.
cn may be NULL to skip name verification; if provided, it is checked against subjectAltName DNS/IP first, then CN if SAN absent; URI is only exact-matched (no RFC 5280 §7.4 normalization).

flags must be non-NULL; on incomplete verification it is set to (uint32_t)-1; on verify failure, returned error is MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_CERT_VERIFY_FAILED and flags contains MBEDTLS_X509_BADCERT_* or MBEDTLS_X509_BADCRL_* bits.

f_vrfy may be NULL; if non-NULL, it is called as f_vrfy(p_vrfy, crt_i, depth, &flags_i). It should return 0 for non-fatal conditions and only non-zero for fatal errors (not MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_CERT_VERIFY_FAILED).
Caller must check return value and inspect *flags when MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_CERT_VERIFY_FAILED is returned.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile(mbedtls_x509_crt *crt, mbedtls_x509_crt *trust_ca, mbedtls_x509_crl *ca_crl, const mbedtls_x509_crt_profile *profile, const char *cn, uint32_t *flags, int (*f_vrfy)(void *, mbedtls_x509_crt *, int, uint32_t *), void *p_vrfy);
functions.description: Verify a certificate chain as in mbedtls_x509_crt_verify, but using an explicit security profile controlling allowed hash algorithms, public-key algorithms/curves, and minimum RSA key size. Restrictions apply to all certificates in the path, including trusted roots.
requirements: profile must point to a valid mbedtls_x509_crt_profile defining allowed algorithms and minimum sizes.
All other requirements from mbedtls_x509_crt_verify apply (trust_ca/ca_crl/cn/flags/f_vrfy usage and semantics).
Caller must handle MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_CERT_VERIFY_FAILED and check flags for details.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_restartable
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_restartable(mbedtls_x509_crt *crt, mbedtls_x509_crt *trust_ca, mbedtls_x509_crl *ca_crl, const mbedtls_x509_crt_profile *profile, const char *cn, uint32_t *flags, int (*f_vrfy)(void *, mbedtls_x509_crt *, int, uint32_t *), void *p_vrfy, mbedtls_x509_crt_restart_ctx *rs_ctx);
functions.description: Restartable version of mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile. It can return early with PSA_OPERATION_INCOMPLETE according to the maximum ECC operation budget set via mbedtls_ecp_set_max_ops(), and can be resumed with the same restart context.
requirements: rs_ctx may be NULL to disable restartable ECC; otherwise must be initialized with mbedtls_x509_crt_restart_init().
May return PSA_OPERATION_INCOMPLETE; caller must retry with the same parameters and rs_ctx until completion or error.
All requirements from mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile apply.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_ca_cb
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_ca_cb(mbedtls_x509_crt *crt, mbedtls_x509_crt_ca_cb_t f_ca_cb, void *p_ca_cb, const mbedtls_x509_crt_profile *profile, const char *cn, uint32_t *flags, int (*f_vrfy)(void *, mbedtls_x509_crt *, int, uint32_t *), void *p_vrfy);
functions.description: Verify a certificate chain like mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile, but obtain candidate trusted CA signers via a user-provided callback instead of a static trust store.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_X509_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_CALLBACK at build time.
f_ca_cb must return 0 on success, setting *candidate_cas to a heap-allocated linked list of mbedtls_x509_crt or NULL if no candidates; non-zero indicates fatal error.
Ownership of the returned candidate list is passed to the verifier; the callback must not free it after return.
All other parameters and behaviors follow mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_check_key_usage
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_check_key_usage(const mbedtls_x509_crt *crt, unsigned int usage);
functions.description: Check that a certificate’s keyUsage extension permits the specified usage bits for a leaf certificate.
requirements: Call this on leaf certificates only; for CA certificates the keyUsage is checked automatically during verification.
If the keyUsage extension is present and does not allow the requested usage bits (with special semantics for decipherOnly/encipherOnly), the function returns MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_BAD_INPUT_DATA.
crt must be a valid certificate pointer.
usage is a bitmask of MBEDTLS_X509_KU_* flags.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_check_extended_key_usage
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509_crt_check_extended_key_usage(const mbedtls_x509_crt *crt, const char *usage_oid, size_t usage_len);
functions.description: Check that a certificate’s extendedKeyUsage extension permits the specified OID (for example, serverAuth or clientAuth) for a leaf certificate.
requirements: crt must be a valid pointer to a certificate.
usage_oid must point to the OID bytes; usage_len is its length (e.g., from MBEDTLS_OID_SIZE()).
Returns 0 if allowed, MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_BAD_INPUT_DATA if not allowed.
Usually only meaningful for leaf certificates.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_is_revoked
functions.description: Check whether a certificate is listed in a given CRL.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_X509_CRL_PARSE_C at build time.
crt and crl must point to valid parsed structures.
Returns 1 if the certificate is revoked, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_init
functions.description: Initialize a certificate chain structure to a safe empty state.
requirements: crt must be a valid pointer; memory for the structure must be provided by the caller before calling.
Call before any parse/verify operations and before using as the head of a chain.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_free
functions.description: Release and zeroize all data held by a certificate chain, including any linked certificates.
requirements: crt may be NULL-safe as per typical Mbed TLS semantics (not explicitly stated); otherwise must point to an initialized chain.
After calling, any buffers provided to nocopy parsing must no longer be used by the library; caller maintains ownership of original buffers.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_restart_init
functions.description: Initialize a restart context for restartable certificate verification.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_ECP_RESTARTABLE at build time.
ctx must be a valid pointer to storage for mbedtls_x509_crt_restart_ctx.
Call before first use in restartable verification and reuse across restarts.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_restart_free
functions.description: Free resources held by a restart context used for restartable verification.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_ECP_RESTARTABLE at build time.
ctx must be a pointer previously initialized with mbedtls_x509_crt_restart_init().
Call when no further restarts are needed.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509_crt_get_ca_istrue
functions.description: Report whether the Basic Constraints extension marks the certificate as a CA certificate.
requirements: crt must not be NULL and must contain a parsed certificate.
Returns 1 if CA, 0 otherwise; returns MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_INVALID_EXTENSIONS if the Basic Constraints extension is absent.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_init
functions.description: Initialize a certificate-writing context for building and outputting X.509 certificates.
requirements: ctx must be a valid pointer to caller-allocated storage.
Call before setting fields or extensions.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_version
functions.description: Set the X.509 version for the certificate being built (defaults to v3).
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
version must be one of MBEDTLS_X509_CRT_VERSION_1, MBEDTLS_X509_CRT_VERSION_2, or MBEDTLS_X509_CRT_VERSION_3.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_serial_raw
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_serial_raw(mbedtls_x509write_cert *ctx, const unsigned char *serial, size_t serial_len);
functions.description: Set the certificate serial number from a raw big-endian byte array.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
serial points to serial number bytes in big-endian order; serial_len is the number of valid bytes.
serial_len must be <= MBEDTLS_X509_RFC5280_MAX_SERIAL_LEN (20); otherwise MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_BAD_INPUT_DATA is returned.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_validity
functions.description: Set the certificate validity period using UTC-time strings formatted as YYYYMMDDhhmmss.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
not_before and not_after must be UTC timestamps in the exact format "YYYYMMDDhhmmss".
Returns 0 on success; otherwise a specific error code if parsing fails.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_issuer_name
functions.description: Set the issuer distinguished name from a comma-separated list of OIDs and values (e.g., "C=UK,O=ARM,CN=Mbed TLS CA").
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
issuer_name must be a properly formatted DN string; function parses and stores it.
Returns 0 on success; otherwise a specific error code if parsing fails.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_subject_name
functions.description: Set the subject distinguished name from a comma-separated list of OIDs and values (e.g., "C=UK,O=ARM,CN=Mbed TLS Server 1").
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
subject_name must be a properly formatted DN string.
Returns 0 on success; otherwise a specific error code if parsing fails.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_subject_key
functions.description: Assign the subject public key to include in the certificate.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
key must point to an initialized public key (mbedtls_pk_context).

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_issuer_key
functions.description: Assign the issuer’s private key to sign the certificate.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
key must be an initialized private key suitable for signing with the selected hash/pk algorithm.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_md_alg
functions.description: Select the message-digest algorithm to use for the certificate signature (e.g., MBEDTLS_MD_SHA256).
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
md_alg must be a supported digest algorithm; compatibility with the issuer key type is required.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_extension
functions.signature: int mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_extension(mbedtls_x509write_cert *ctx, const char *oid, size_t oid_len, int critical, const unsigned char *val, size_t val_len);
functions.description: Add or replace an arbitrary certificate extension by OID, with control over the critical flag and raw OCTET STRING value.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
oid must point to the extension OID bytes; oid_len is their length.
val must point to the raw DER content to be wrapped as the extension’s OCTET STRING; val_len is its length.
critical is non-zero to mark the extension critical.
May allocate memory; handle PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.
Returns 0 on success.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_basic_constraints
functions.description: Set the Basic Constraints extension, indicating whether the certificate is a CA and optionally the maximum path length for subordinate certificates.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
is_ca indicates CA status; max_pathlen is only meaningful if is_ca is true; -1 indicates unlimited path length.
May allocate memory; returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_subject_key_identifier
functions.description: Add the Subject Key Identifier extension derived from the subject public key.
requirements: Available only if PSA_WANT_ALG_SHA_1 is enabled at build time.
ctx must be initialized and mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_subject_key() must have been called beforehand.
May allocate memory; returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_authority_key_identifier
functions.description: Add the Authority Key Identifier extension derived from the issuer key.
requirements: Available only if PSA_WANT_ALG_SHA_1 is enabled at build time.
ctx must be initialized and mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_issuer_key() must have been called beforehand.
May allocate memory; returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_key_usage
functions.description: Set the Key Usage extension flags for the certificate (e.g., MBEDTLS_X509_KU_DIGITAL_SIGNATURE).
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
key_usage is a bitmask of MBEDTLS_X509_KU_* flags.
May allocate memory; returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_ext_key_usage
functions.description: Set the Extended Key Usage extension as a sequence of OIDs.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
exts must point to a sequence of MBEDTLS_ASN1_OID entries describing allowed EKUs.
May allocate memory; returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_set_ns_cert_type
functions.description: Set the (legacy) Netscape Certificate Type extension flags.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
ns_cert_type is a bitmask of MBEDTLS_X509_NS_CERT_TYPE_* flags.
May allocate memory; returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_free
functions.description: Free resources held by a certificate-writing context.
requirements: ctx must be a pointer to a write context previously initialized with mbedtls_x509write_crt_init().
After freeing, the context must be reinitialized before reuse.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_der
functions.description: Serialize the built certificate into DER format, writing data at the end of the provided buffer. The return value is the length of the DER data; use it to locate the start within the buffer.
requirements: ctx must be fully configured (subject/issuer names, keys, validity, version, MD algorithm, and any desired extensions).
buf must be a writable buffer of length at least size; data is written backwards from the end.
Caller must handle negative error codes; on success, the function returns the number of bytes written.
Ensure issuer key matches subject if self-signed, or is appropriate for cross-signing.

functions.name: mbedtls_x509write_crt_pem
functions.description: Serialize the built certificate into PEM format into the provided buffer.
requirements: Requires MBEDTLS_PEM_WRITE_C at build time.
ctx must be fully configured as for DER writing.
buf must be a writable buffer sufficiently large to hold the PEM output including NUL-terminator.
Returns 0 on success or a specific error code on failure.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_list_ciphersuites
functions.description: Returns a library-owned list of supported TLS ciphersuite identifiers. Intended for iterating over the ciphersuites supported by the current Mbed TLS build/configuration. The storage is owned by the library and must not be modified or freed by the caller. Exact list length or termination details are not documented in this header; consult the library docs or implementation if needed.
requirements: Function takes no parameters.
Returned pointer, if non-NULL, is library-owned and read-only; do not modify or free.

Method of determining the list length/termination is unknown from this header; caller must handle iteration defensively (e.g., by consulting official docs or checking for implementation-defined terminators).

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_from_string
functions.description: Looks up ciphersuite information by its (IANA) name string and returns a pointer to the corresponding ciphersuite descriptor. Useful for mapping human-readable ciphersuite names to the internal descriptor used by Mbed TLS. Returns a const pointer; the data is library-owned and must not be modified or freed. If the name is not recognized, the function is expected to return NULL (behavior not explicitly stated here, but typical for Mbed TLS).
requirements: ciphersuite_name should point to a valid, null-terminated, readable string.
ciphersuite_name must name a ciphersuite supported/enabled in the current build to obtain a non-NULL result.
The returned mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_t pointer, if non-NULL, is library-owned; do not modify or free.
Behavior on ciphersuite_name == NULL is not specified in this header; avoid passing NULL.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_from_id
functions.description: Looks up ciphersuite information by its numeric ciphersuite identifier and returns a pointer to the corresponding ciphersuite descriptor. Use constants defined in this header (e.g., MBEDTLS_TLS1_3_AES_128_GCM_SHA256). Returns a const pointer; the data is library-owned. If the ID is not recognized/supported, the function is expected to return NULL (not explicitly stated here).
requirements: ciphersuite_id should be a valid ciphersuite identifier defined by this header and enabled in the current build to obtain a non-NULL result.
The returned mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_t pointer, if non-NULL, is library-owned; do not modify or free.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_get_name
functions.description: Returns the IANA name string for the provided ciphersuite descriptor. Useful for logging or presenting the human-readable ciphersuite name. The returned pointer refers to library-owned storage.
requirements: info must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_t obtained from this library.
The returned string pointer is library-owned and read-only; do not modify or free.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_get_id
functions.description: Returns the numeric ciphersuite identifier for the provided ciphersuite descriptor. Useful for comparing or serializing ciphersuite selections.
requirements: info must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_t obtained from this library.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_get_cipher_key_bitlen
functions.description: Returns the symmetric cipher key length, in bits, for the given ciphersuite descriptor. Intended for determining key sizes when handling cipher-specific logic. The exact meaning corresponds to the underlying cipher of the ciphersuite (e.g., 128 or 256 for AES-based suites).
requirements: info must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid mbedtls_ssl_ciphersuite_t obtained from this library.
Caller should be prepared for any valid size_t result corresponding to the ciphersuite’s cipher; precise values per suite are not documented here.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_get_ciphersuite_name
functions.description: Return a human-readable name string for the given ciphersuite ID. Useful for logging and diagnostics.
requirements: ciphersuite_id may be any integer; if unknown, the function returns a non-NULL or possibly NULL depending on library build (documentation says 'a string containing the ciphersuite name').
Return value is a const pointer owned by the library; do not modify or free.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_get_ciphersuite_id
functions.description: Return the IANA ciphersuite ID corresponding to the given name string.
requirements: ciphersuite_name must be a valid, null-terminated string naming a supported ciphersuite.
Returns 0 if not found.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_init
functions.description: Initialize an SSL context to a clean state so it can be set up with mbedtls_ssl_setup() or freed with mbedtls_ssl_free().
requirements: ssl must be a valid pointer to writable memory.
Call exactly once per fresh context before other SSL APIs except free.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_setup
functions.description: Bind a prepared configuration to an initialized SSL context and allocate internal resources. Must be called exactly once per context before starting a handshake.
requirements: ssl must have been initialized with mbedtls_ssl_init().
conf must have been initialized (typically via mbedtls_ssl_config_init() and configured).
psa_crypto_init() must have been called before this function.
Do not modify or free conf while the session is active.
Do not call this function more than once per context.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_session_reset
functions.description: Reset an SSL context for reuse while retaining application-set callbacks and configuration.
requirements: ssl must have been initialized (and typically set up earlier).
May return PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY or MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_HW_ACCEL_FAILED; caller must handle and avoid using the context if failure persists.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_endpoint
functions.description: Set endpoint role in a configuration as client or server.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
endpoint must be MBEDTLS_SSL_IS_CLIENT or MBEDTLS_SSL_IS_SERVER.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_transport
functions.description: Configure transport to TLS (stream) or DTLS (datagram).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
transport must be MBEDTLS_SSL_TRANSPORT_STREAM or MBEDTLS_SSL_TRANSPORT_DATAGRAM.
For DTLS, you must provide timer callbacks via mbedtls_ssl_set_timer_cb() and a nonblocking recv or recv_timeout in mbedtls_ssl_set_bio().

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_authmode
functions.description: Set peer certificate verification mode (none, optional, required).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
authmode must be one of MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_NONE, MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_OPTIONAL, MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_REQUIRED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_early_data
functions.description: Enable or disable TLS 1.3 early data (0-RTT) support on the configuration.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
early_data_enabled must be MBEDTLS_SSL_EARLY_DATA_DISABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_EARLY_DATA_ENABLED.
Security properties of 0-RTT are weaker; caller should ensure application semantics tolerate replay.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_max_early_data_size
functions.description: Server-side: set the max number of early-data bytes clients may send with tickets issued by this configuration.
requirements: conf must be initialized (server-side).
Takes effect for tickets issued after setting; does not affect previously issued tickets.
Value should be large enough for anticipated early data to avoid connection termination when exceeded.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_verify
functions.signature: void mbedtls_ssl_conf_verify(mbedtls_ssl_config *conf, int (*f_vrfy)(void *, mbedtls_x509_crt *, int, uint32_t *), void *p_vrfy);
functions.description: Register a configuration-wide X.509 certificate verification callback and its context.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
f_vrfy may be NULL to clear the callback; when set, it must follow mbedtls_x509_crt_verify() semantics.
If both per-config and per-context verify callbacks are set, per-context (mbedtls_ssl_set_verify) takes precedence.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_dbg
functions.signature: void mbedtls_ssl_conf_dbg(mbedtls_ssl_config *conf, void (*f_dbg)(void *, int, const char *, int, const char *), void *p_dbg);
functions.description: Set a debug logging callback and its context for this configuration.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
f_dbg may be NULL to disable debug output.
Callback must be thread-safe if used from multiple threads.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_bio
functions.signature: void mbedtls_ssl_set_bio(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, void *p_bio, mbedtls_ssl_send_t *f_send, mbedtls_ssl_recv_t *f_recv, mbedtls_ssl_recv_timeout_t *f_recv_timeout);
functions.description: Attach I/O callbacks and user I/O context to an SSL context for sending and receiving over the underlying transport.
requirements: ssl must be initialized and set up.
p_bio is stored and passed to callbacks; must remain valid while in use.
At least one of f_recv or f_recv_timeout must be non-NULL; if both provided, f_recv_timeout is used.
Callbacks must follow the conventions documented (return counts or MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_WANT_READ/WRITE/MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_TIMEOUT for timeout variant).
For DTLS, provide either nonblocking f_recv or a valid f_recv_timeout.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_cid
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_set_cid(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, int enable, unsigned char const *own_cid, size_t own_cid_len);
functions.description: Configure DTLS Connection ID (CID) usage for the next handshake and optionally set our inbound CID value.
requirements: ssl must be initialized; DTLS CID feature must be enabled in build.
enable must be MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_ENABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_DISABLED.
If enable is enabled, own_cid may be NULL only if own_cid_len is 0; otherwise own_cid must point to readable buffer.
own_cid_len must match the length configured in mbedtls_ssl_conf_cid() for the bound configuration.
Takes effect on the next handshake; does not trigger a handshake.
If negotiated, the stack will drop packets with unexpected CID; underlying transport must demultiplex accordingly.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_get_own_cid
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_get_own_cid(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, int *enabled, unsigned char own_cid[MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_IN_LEN_MAX], size_t *own_cid_len);
functions.description: Query whether CID use is requested for the next handshake and retrieve our configured inbound CID value.
requirements: ssl must be valid.
enabled must be non-NULL.
If own_cid is non-NULL, own_cid_len must be non-NULL; if own_cid_len is NULL, own_cid must be NULL.
If requesting an empty CID, enabled is reported as MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_DISABLED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_get_peer_cid
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_get_peer_cid(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, int *enabled, unsigned char peer_cid[MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX], size_t *peer_cid_len);
functions.description: Query whether CID is in use for the current connection and retrieve the peer’s chosen CID for our outgoing records.
requirements: ssl must be valid; may attempt to complete a handshake in progress.
enabled must be non-NULL.
If peer_cid is non-NULL, peer_cid_len must be non-NULL; if peer_cid_len is NULL, peer_cid must be NULL.
If both sides chose empty CID, enabled will be MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_DISABLED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_mtu
functions.description: Set the DTLS path MTU for outgoing datagrams (0 means unset). Controls maximum datagram payload the stack will emit to f_send().
requirements: ssl must be initialized.
Only decreases effective maximum; values smaller than current record expansion will cause send errors upon use.
Does not limit receive size.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_verify
functions.signature: void mbedtls_ssl_set_verify(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, int (*f_vrfy)(void *, mbedtls_x509_crt *, int, uint32_t *), void *p_vrfy);
functions.description: Set a per-connection X.509 chain verification callback and context. Overrides configuration-level callback for this connection.
requirements: ssl must be initialized.
f_vrfy may be NULL to clear the per-connection override.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_read_timeout
functions.description: Set timeout for mbedtls_ssl_read() when using blocking I/O via recv_timeout or when using nonblocking I/O with timers.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
If using blocking I/O, f_recv_timeout must be set via mbedtls_ssl_set_bio().
If using nonblocking I/O, timer callbacks must be set via mbedtls_ssl_set_timer_cb().

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_check_record
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_check_record(mbedtls_ssl_context const *ssl, unsigned char *buf, size_t buflen);
functions.description: DTLS-only: Check if the first record in a provided datagram buffer is a valid, authentic and not-yet-seen record. Does not change user-visible state but may invalidate the SSL context on fatal errors.
requirements: ssl must reference a DTLS connection.
buf must point to a read/write buffer of length buflen; function may modify buf.
Only the first record in buf is checked; any subsequent records are ignored.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_timer_cb
functions.description: Set DTLS timer callbacks and context used for handshake retransmission timing and timeouts.
requirements: ssl must be initialized.
f_set_timer and f_get_timer must implement the documented semantics (store delays and report states -1/0/1/2).
p_timer must remain valid while in use.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_cert_cb
functions.description: Server-side: register a certificate selection callback invoked after ClientHello processing for each handshake.
requirements: conf must be initialized and used server-side.
f_cert_cb may be NULL to clear. Callback must return 0 on success or an MBEDTLS_ERR_XXX to abort handshake.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_session_tickets_cb
functions.description: Server: enable and configure session tickets by providing write/parse callbacks and their shared context.
requirements: conf must be initialized (server-side).
To enable tickets, both f_ticket_write and f_ticket_parse must be non-NULL.
p_ticket must remain valid for the lifetime of conf or until reconfigured.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_dtls_cookies
functions.description: Server/DTLS: register HelloVerifyRequest cookie write/check callbacks to mitigate amplification attacks or set NULL to disable verification.
requirements: conf must be initialized and DTLS server build enabled.
Default dummy callbacks fail; you must register working callbacks unless intentionally disabling.
To disable hello verification, pass NULL callbacks, understanding DoS risk.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_client_transport_id
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_set_client_transport_id(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, const unsigned char *info, size_t ilen);
functions.description: Server/DTLS: set client's transport-level identification info (e.g., IP:port) for cookie mechanisms and reconnection handling. Makes an internal copy.
requirements: ssl must be a server-side DTLS context.
info must point to identification bytes of length ilen; an internal copy is made.
Returns PSA_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT if used on client, PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY on OOM.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_dtls_anti_replay
functions.description: Enable or disable DTLS anti-replay protection (default enabled).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
mode must be MBEDTLS_SSL_ANTI_REPLAY_ENABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_ANTI_REPLAY_DISABLED.
Disabling is a security risk unless application handles duplicates safely.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_dtls_badmac_limit
functions.description: Set a limit for the number of records with bad MAC (authentication failures) before terminating the DTLS connection (0 disables).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
limit is the count at which the connection is terminated on the Nth non-authentic record.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_datagram_packing
functions.description: DTLS: allow packing multiple handshake records in one datagram to reduce overhead and improve efficiency (enabled by default).
requirements: ssl must be initialized.
allow_packing 0 disables, 1 enables.
Intended primarily for testing or interop issues if disabled.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_handshake_timeout
functions.description: DTLS: set retransmission timeout range for handshake (defaults 1000ms..60000ms).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
min and max are in milliseconds; typical min slightly exceeds RTT + peer processing time.
Messages are retransmitted up to log2(ceil(max/min)) times.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_session_cache
functions.description: Server: register session cache get/set callbacks and their context to enable TLS 1.2 session resumption via IDs.
requirements: conf must be initialized (server-side).
p_cache must remain valid while callbacks are in use.
Callbacks must manage staleness/timeouts; do not cache peer_cert pointer directly (copy if needed).

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_session
functions.description: Client: load a saved session to attempt session resumption in the next handshake.
requirements: ssl must be initialized, set up with configuration, and handshake must not have started.
session must be previously obtained from mbedtls_ssl_get_session() and possibly serialized/deserialized via save/load.
Returns MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE if a session is already loaded (non-fatal).

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_session_load
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_session_load(mbedtls_ssl_session *session, const unsigned char *buf, size_t len);
functions.description: Load serialized session data into an initialized, yet-unpopulated session structure.
requirements: session must have been initialized with mbedtls_ssl_session_init() and not populated.
buf must point to readable serialized data of length len.
On failure may return PSA_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY, PSA_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT, or MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_VERSION_MISMATCH.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_session_save
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_session_save(const mbedtls_ssl_session *session, unsigned char *buf, size_t buf_len, size_t *olen);
functions.description: Serialize a session to a buffer for storage. Works for TLS 1.3 only if session tickets are enabled.
requirements: session must be valid (e.g., obtained via mbedtls_ssl_get_session()).
olen must be non-NULL; it is updated with required/actual size regardless of buffer size.
If buf_len is too small, returns PSA_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL and sets olen.
Returns MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE if session is TLS 1.3 and tickets are disabled.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_ciphersuites
functions.description: Set the allowed ciphersuites (mix of TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 IDs) and preference order for a configuration.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
ciphersuites must be a 0-terminated array of IANA ciphersuite IDs and must remain valid for the lifetime of conf.
Server preference vs client preference may be controlled separately (see mbedtls_ssl_conf_preference_order()).

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_tls13_key_exchange_modes
functions.description: TLS 1.3: configure supported key exchange modes (PSK, ephemeral, or both).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
kex_modes is a bitwise combination of MBEDTLS_SSL_TLS1_3_KEY_EXCHANGE_MODE_{PSK,EPHEMERAL,PSK_EPHEMERAL}.
If PSK modes are enabled, PSKs must also be configured (mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk/_opaque/_cb).
For pure-ephemeral mode on server, you must configure a certificate via mbedtls_ssl_conf_own_cert().

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_cid
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_conf_cid(mbedtls_ssl_config *conf, size_t len, int ignore_other_cids);
functions.description: DTLS CID: set length of incoming Connection IDs and behavior on unexpected CIDs for a configuration.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
len must be <= MBEDTLS_SSL_CID_OUT_LEN_MAX; otherwise PSA_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT is returned.
ignore_other_cids must be MBEDTLS_SSL_UNEXPECTED_CID_IGNORE or MBEDTLS_SSL_UNEXPECTED_CID_FAIL.
All connections sharing this conf use a common incoming CID length.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_cert_profile
functions.description: Configure the X.509 verification security profile (limits acceptable algorithms, key sizes, etc.).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
profile must outlive the configuration or remain valid while used.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_ca_chain
functions.description: Set trusted CA chain and CRLs used to verify peer certificates.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
ca_chain/ca_crl pointers must remain valid while used by any contexts bound to conf, unless a CA callback is configured later which overrides.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_ca_cb
functions.description: Register a trusted-certificate callback to supply trusted CAs dynamically instead of a static linked list.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
Incompatible with mbedtls_ssl_conf_ca_chain() and CRLs; calling this overwrites previous CA/CRL settings and disables CRL usage.
Callback must be thread-safe if used in multi-threaded environment.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_own_cert
functions.description: Register own certificate chain and matching private key for use in handshakes (server can register multiple, client only first is used).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
pk_key must match the public key in the first certificate in own_cert; this function does not verify the match.
On server you may call multiple times to add alternatives; selection is based on client capabilities and first-set preference.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk(mbedtls_ssl_config *conf, const unsigned char *psk, size_t psk_len, const unsigned char *psk_identity, size_t psk_identity_len);
functions.description: Configure a raw pre-shared key and identity for PSK-based cipher suites (primarily for clients).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
Only one PSK can be configured (either raw or opaque); configuring more returns MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE.
psk and identity are copied internally; supply valid pointers for the call duration only.
A PSK set during a PSK callback (set via mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk_cb) or mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_psk() takes precedence.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk_opaque
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk_opaque(mbedtls_ssl_config *conf, mbedtls_svc_key_id_t psk, const unsigned char *psk_identity, size_t psk_identity_len);
functions.description: Configure an opaque PSK (PSA key slot) and identity for PSK-based cipher suites (primarily for clients).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
Only one PSK (raw or opaque) can be configured; otherwise returns MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE.
The PSA key slot must contain a key of type PSA_ALG_CATEGORY_KEY_DERIVATION with policy allowing the handshake’s KDF for as long as conf is used.
psk_identity bytes are copied internally.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_psk
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_psk(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, const unsigned char *psk, size_t psk_len);
functions.description: Within a server PSK callback, set the raw PSK for the current handshake. Overrides any statically configured PSK.
requirements: ssl must be in a PSK callback context (called from function registered via mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk_cb()).
psk must point to the PSK bytes of length psk_len valid for the handshake duration.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_psk_opaque
functions.description: Within a server PSK callback, set the opaque PSK key slot for the current handshake. Overrides any statically configured opaque PSK.
requirements: ssl must be in a PSK callback context.
The PSA key slot must be populated with a suitable key for the handshake KDF and remain valid for the handshake duration.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk_cb
functions.signature: void mbedtls_ssl_conf_psk_cb(mbedtls_ssl_config *conf, int (*f_psk)(void *, mbedtls_ssl_context *, const unsigned char *, size_t), void *p_psk);
functions.description: Server: register a PSK identity lookup callback, which sets the correct PSK (raw or opaque) for the current handshake via mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_psk[_opaque]().
requirements: conf must be initialized (server-side).
f_psk must return 0 after calling one of mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_psk() or mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_psk_opaque() for a valid identity; any other return denies the identity.
A dynamic PSK set by the callback takes precedence over statically configured PSKs.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_groups
functions.description: Set allowed TLS key exchange groups (IANA NamedGroup IDs) in order of preference for ECDHE/DHE, etc.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
groups must be a 0-terminated array of valid IANA NamedGroup IDs and remain valid for the lifetime of conf.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_sig_algs
functions.description: Configure allowed signature algorithms for TLS 1.2/1.3 (IANA values) for certificate-based handshakes.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
sig_algs must be a list terminated by MBEDTLS_TLS1_3_SIG_NONE and remain valid for the lifetime of conf.
For TLS 1.2, values are (HashAlgorithm << 8) | SignatureAlgorithm; for 1.3 use MBEDTLS_TLS1_3_SIG_* constants.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hostname
functions.description: Client: set or clear the expected server hostname for certificate verification and SNI. Also stored in TLS 1.3 tickets if enabled.
requirements: ssl must be initialized.
hostname may be NULL to clear; otherwise must be a null-terminated string with length <= MBEDTLS_SSL_MAX_HOST_NAME_LEN.
On success, internal copy is made; on allocation failure, stored hostname is cleared; on too-long input, old hostname is unchanged.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_get_hs_sni
functions.description: Retrieve the SNI value from the current handshake inside the certificate selection callback. Returns a non-null, non-NUL-terminated pointer valid only during the callback.
requirements: ssl must currently be inside f_cert_cb registered via mbedtls_ssl_conf_cert_cb().
name_len must be non-NULL to obtain length; 0 indicates SNI not present or not yet processed.
Returned pointer must not be freed and is only valid during the callback.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_own_cert
functions.description: Within SNI/certificate selection callback, set the certificate and key to use for the current handshake. Passing NULL own_cert clears the list for this handshake.
requirements: ssl must be in the SNI or certificate selection callback context.
pk_key must match own_cert public key if own_cert is non-NULL.
May be called repeatedly to add alternatives.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_ca_chain
functions.description: Within SNI/certificate selection callback, set CA chain and CRLs to verify the peer for the current handshake.
requirements: ssl must be in SNI/cert selection callback context.
ca_chain/ca_crl must remain valid at least through the handshake.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_dn_hints
functions.description: Within SNI/certificate selection callback, set DN hints to include issuer DNs in the CertificateRequest for this handshake.
requirements: ssl must be in the callback context.
crt must remain valid for the handshake duration.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_authmode
functions.description: Within SNI/certificate selection callback, set the client authentication mode for this handshake.
requirements: ssl must be in callback context.
authmode must be MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_NONE, MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_OPTIONAL, or MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_REQUIRED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_sni
functions.signature: void mbedtls_ssl_conf_sni(mbedtls_ssl_config *conf, int (*f_sni)(void *, mbedtls_ssl_context *, const unsigned char *, size_t), void *p_sni);
functions.description: Server: set SNI callback to select certificates and verification settings based on the client-provided server name.
requirements: conf must be initialized (server-side).
f_sni must set certificates via mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_own_cert() and optionally CA/CRL and authmode, then return 0 on success; non-zero aborts handshake.
p_sni is stored and passed to callback; must remain valid.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_ecjpake_password
functions.signature: int mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_ecjpake_password(mbedtls_ssl_context *ssl, const unsigned char *pw, size_t pw_len);
functions.description: Set EC J-PAKE password (pre-shared secret) for the current handshake. An internal copy is made and destroyed at handshake end/reset/free.
requirements: ssl must be set up; call between mbedtls_ssl_setup()/mbedtls_ssl_session_reset() and mbedtls_ssl_handshake().
pw must not be empty; pw_len > 0.
Returns 0 on success or negative error.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_set_hs_ecjpake_password_opaque
functions.description: Set EC J-PAKE opaque password (PSA key) for the current handshake. No copy is made; key must remain valid until handshake completes.
requirements: ssl must be set up; call before or during handshake as documented.
pwd must reference a valid key in PSA keystore for the handshake duration.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_alpn_protocols
functions.description: Configure supported ALPN protocol names (ordered by preference).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
protos must be a NULL-terminated array of strings; the array pointer must remain valid for the lifetime of conf.
Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid list.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_get_alpn_protocol
functions.description: Return the negotiated ALPN protocol after the handshake or NULL if none was negotiated.
requirements: ssl must be a valid pointer.
Call after handshake completes.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_srtp_mki_value_supported
functions.description: Enable/disable DTLS-SRTP MKI usage support in the use_srtp extension (default unsupported).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
support_mki_value must be MBEDTLS_SSL_DTLS_SRTP_MKI_UNSUPPORTED or MBEDTLS_SSL_DTLS_SRTP_MKI_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_dtls_srtp_protection_profiles
functions.description: Set supported DTLS-SRTP protection profiles (ordered by preference).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
profiles must be terminated by MBEDTLS_TLS_SRTP_UNSET, contain no more than MBEDTLS_TLS_SRTP_MAX_PROFILE_LIST_LENGTH entries (excluding terminator), and remain valid.
Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT for malformed list.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_dtls_srtp_set_mki_value
functions.description: Client: set SRTP MKI value for the current DTLS-SRTP session.
requirements: ssl must be initialized (client-side relevance).
mki_value must point to at least mki_len bytes.
Returns 0 on success, PSA_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad input, MBEDTLS_ERR_SSL_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE if unsupported.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_get_dtls_srtp_negotiation_result
functions.description: Retrieve negotiated DTLS-SRTP profile and MKI info after the handshake.
requirements: ssl must be valid.
dtls_srtp_info must be a valid pointer to writable struct.
Must be called after handshake completes; values are not trustworthy before completion.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_encrypt_then_mac
functions.description: Enable or disable Encrypt-then-MAC negotiation (default enabled). Security improvement; should typically remain enabled.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
etm must be MBEDTLS_SSL_ETM_ENABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_ETM_DISABLED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_extended_master_secret
functions.description: Enable or disable Extended Master Secret negotiation (default enabled).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
ems must be MBEDTLS_SSL_EXTENDED_MS_ENABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_EXTENDED_MS_DISABLED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_cert_req_ca_list
functions.description: Server: choose whether to send acceptable CA list in CertificateRequest messages (default enabled).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
cert_req_ca_list must be MBEDTLS_SSL_CERT_REQ_CA_LIST_ENABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_CERT_REQ_CA_LIST_DISABLED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_max_frag_len
functions.description: Set Max Fragment Length to emit and/or negotiate. Affects record payload sizes.
requirements: conf must be initialized.
mfl_code must be one of MBEDTLS_SSL_MAX_FRAG_LEN_{512,1024,2048,4096}; MBEDTLS_SSL_MAX_FRAG_LEN_NONE means do not use extension.
Returns 0 on success or PSA_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT on invalid code.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_preference_order
functions.description: Server: select whether to prefer server or client ciphersuite order during negotiation.
requirements: conf must be initialized (server-side).
order must be MBEDTLS_SSL_SRV_CIPHERSUITE_ORDER_SERVER or MBEDTLS_SSL_SRV_CIPHERSUITE_ORDER_CLIENT.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_session_tickets
functions.description: Client: enable or disable session ticket usage (default enabled).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
use_tickets must be MBEDTLS_SSL_SESSION_TICKETS_ENABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_SESSION_TICKETS_DISABLED.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_new_session_tickets
functions.description: Server/TLS 1.3: set number of NewSessionTicket messages to send after handshake completion (default MBEDTLS_SSL_TLS1_3_DEFAULT_NEW_SESSION_TICKETS).
requirements: conf must be initialized (server-side, TLS 1.3 and tickets enabled).
Note: in session resumption, at most one ticket is sent to renew client’s pool.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_renegotiation
functions.description: Enable or disable peer-initiated renegotiation support (default disabled).
requirements: conf must be initialized.
renegotiation must be MBEDTLS_SSL_RENEGOTIATION_ENABLED or MBEDTLS_SSL_RENEGOTIATION_DISABLED.
Enabling has security and DoS implications; use only if necessary.

functions.name: mbedtls_ssl_conf_legacy_renegotiation
functions.description: Control behavior with peers that do not support secure renegotiation: allow connections but no renegotiation, allow legacy renegotiation, or break handshake.
